description: Match intercepted bootstrap routes to actual frame rather than request arrival order; deterministically test reversed parent arrival order. Hide progress bar on terminal session failure and prevent decorative canvas intercepting reload clicks. Validate macOS WebKit and Chromium session-race suites on existing readiness branch.

comments.text: Fixed CI regressions from run 38061477830 / PR #22. Partition test now associates each intercepted initial bootstrap with its request frame, and deterministically covers both arrival orders without weakening cookie partition assertions. Terminal session failure cancels/hides topbar and prevents subsequent loading events from restarting it; dedicated progress class disables pointer interception. Regression tests exercise visible progress, pending progress cancellation, later loading events and ordinary reload click. Rebuilt tracked browser assets. Validation: npm build passed; full Chromium + macOS WebKit E2E run passed 267 tests (134 Chromium, 133 WebKit), 1 existing WebKit skip for Chromium-specific third-party blocking; mix precommit passed 230 tests; git diff --check clean. Initial broad run hit an execution timeout, rerun with sufficient budget completed successfully in 13.2m. Firefox not run.

title: Fix partition race and recovery reload E2E failures
